department: Faculty of Science — Department of Statistics and Data Science

deadline.value: Main Round and HKPFS application deadline for August 2027 entry is December 1, 2026 (Clearing Round: March 31, 2027, subject to availability).
deadline.quote: For applicants who apply for M.Phil./Ph.D. programme directly with CUHK (i.e. non-HKPFS applicants), the application deadline for Main Round is 1 December 2026, and that for Clearing Round is 31 March 2027

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in this field).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Department notes that indicating a preference for a prospective advisor increases admission odds.
supervisor.quote: Please note that indication of the preference for your future advisor will increase your odds to get admitted to our PhD/MPhil in Statistics program

funding.value: Qualified full-time research postgraduate students receive Postgraduate Studentships (HK$229,200/yr, approx. HK$19,100/mo or US$29,400/yr in 2026-27) during the normative study period; HKPFS provides HK$28,700/mo plus HK$14,400/yr travel allowance and CUHK tuition waiver.
funding.quote: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400). Payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits both bachelor's holders (direct to pre-candidacy PhD or MPhil stream) and master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Articulated MPhil-PhD programmes provide a pathway for students with a Bachelor's degree to pursue a PhD. Initially, students are admitted as either MPhil students or pre-candidacy PhD students.

notes: Department of Statistics and Data Science offers research specializations across mathematical statistics, biostatistics, financial statistics, data science, and machine learning.
